5.0.SP2.description: TotalNetValue is determined as follows: At the initial collateral assignment TotalNetValue <900> is the sum of ( UnderlyingStartValue <884> * (1-haircut)). In a collateral substitution TotalNetValue <900> is the sum of ( UnderlyingCurrentValue <885> * (1-haircut)). For listed derivatives clearing margin management, this is the collateral value which equals (Market value * haircut)
